objective: T-20260929-72: does the SEC fails-to-deliver balance (FTDSH = fails/shares, FTDADV = fails x price / 21d dollar ADV, high = lower return) rank next-open returns in the ADV top-1500 pool (price >= 5) in 2024+ and 2019+, PIT-lagged by SEC publication? Only if the cheap IC gate passes are 4 preregistered avoid / short books screened.
target_regime_and_horizon: US common stocks, cross-sectional 20 and 60 session horizons, monthly rebalance; recent window 2024-01-01 onward, full sample from the first usable file (2019). No regime validity is assumed; a pass would be recent-window evidence with a 2019-2023 stress period.
existing_solution_comparison: Published: Stratmann-Welborn (JEF 2016) and Autore-Boulton-Braga-Alves (FR 2015), abstracts only, both pre-2019 samples, effect sizes unread; Boni 2006 on strategic fails. No public product or live record found that trades FTD balances. Why not enough: no post-2019 or top-1500-pool evidence, nothing net of the SEC's 15 day lag, 10 bp costs and borrow; local repo has never computed FTD (dir:sec_fails_to_deliver_signal queued, evidence_too_weak).
remaining_evidence_gap: Effect sizes and horizons of the cited papers were not read (paywalled abstract pages only); Welborn 2025 draft not read. The SEC served no file for 2019-10a, 2020-02..04 and 2026-05 (HTTP 404 on 2026-09-29), so those windows are NaN. Tickers are matched exactly; class-share tickers with dots do not match SIP symbols.
negative_experiments_checked: oc research directions check fails to deliver (2026-09-29): dir:sec_fails_to_deliver_signal queued; short-interest and short-volume siblings (dir:short_interest_ratio_crowding_factor refuted, dir:finra_daily_short_volume_bjz refuted) are different series, not reused. Local data/raw and data/features hold no FTD series.
cost_and_execution_assumptions: Signal usable from the first session after the SEC file cutoff, entry at the next open (one further session); 10 bp per side (20 bp check); short leg only in ADV top 500 with borrow 3%/yr and a 252d SPY beta hedge; monthly rebalance with 21 offsets, median offset decides. Prices pass sanitize_price_matrices defaults inside signal_card. Stress window 2019-2023 only.
stop_condition: Stage 1 (signal_card rank mode, ADV top 1500, horizons 20 and 60, FTDSH and FTDADV): continue for a signal only if at one horizon BOTH hold: 2024+ mean RankIC of -signal is positive (high FTD -> lower return) with Newey-West |t| >= 2.5; full-sample (2019+) mean RankIC has the same sign. Otherwise stop, registry refuted, no ledger, close the short-selling-information cell. Stage 2 verdicts use runbook K1/K2/watch_recent unchanged. No threshold, sign, horizon or candidate changes after results.

queries.query: fails-to-deliver stock returns predictability naked short selling Boni Autore Kimball Jarrow
SEC fails to deliver data SHO threshold securities return predictability study 2020 2023

sources.claim: SEC FTD files are pipe-delimited half-month files (a: first half posted at month end; b: about the 15th of the next month) listing every security with a non-zero balance since 2008-09-16; the price field is the previous day close; the SEC says fails arise on long and short sales and are not evidence of naked shorting.
sources.limitations: Page extract via WebFetch summariser (raw curl was rate-limited with HTTP 403); the extract preserves the field list and the quoted caveat.

sources.claim: Reg SHO threshold security: aggregate fail-to-deliver position at NSCC for five consecutive settlement days of 10,000 shares or more equal to at least 0.5% of shares outstanding; the FTDSH signal (fails / shares outstanding) is a continuous version of that ratio.
sources.limitations: Definition page; says nothing about returns.

sources.claim: Stratmann and Welborn (J. Empirical Finance 2016): stocks with fails-to-deliver experience negative abnormal returns proportional to their FTD levels (event study and Fama-French portfolio analysis); short sellers of low and high FTD stocks obtain positive estimated profits net of proprietary borrow costs; FTDs reflect nonbinding short sale constraints.
sources.limitations: Abstract page only (full text paywalled); sample period, horizon and effect size not read; period of the study predates 2019 and uses proprietary borrow-cost data we do not have.

sources.claim: Autore, Boulton and Braga-Alves (Financial Review 2015): stocks reaching threshold levels of failures become significantly overvalued, with reversals where short-sale constraints bind, but the mispricing is likely difficult to arbitrage because of extreme shorting costs.
sources.limitations: Abstract page only; threshold-list stocks (a tail of FTD), pre-2015 sample; effect size not read. Supports the sign (high FTD -> lower later return) and the shortability warning.

cheapest_decisive_test.action: Download the half-month FTD files (scripts/fetch_sec_ftd.py), build PIT FTDSH/FTDADV (scripts/build_ftd_signal.py), run signal_card rank mode (ADV top 1500, direction -1, primary horizon 20 and 60) and a Newey-West companion (scripts/ftd_ic_test.py); no book before this passes.
cheapest_decisive_test.pass_condition: At 20d or 60d for a signal: 2024+ RankIC of -signal positive with NW |t| >= 2.5 and full-sample same sign.
cheapest_decisive_test.falsification_condition: Any condition fails at both horizons for both signals.
